headline: 6 of 7 pods leave live bacteria
primary_text: A 90-day side-by-side lab test of seven leading ultrasonic dental cleaners revealed that most units available online fall short on deep decontamination. While many brands look identical on the outside, subsequent microscopic testing showed that six out of seven machines left live bacterial biofilm active on appliances overnight. Most consumer pods fail because they lack the specific mechanical frequency required to penetrate porous acrylic or use weak UV-C wavelengths that do not fully sanitize. This engineered unit was the only system tested that completely cleared subsurface buildup without damaging the appliance material.
